description: For an equivalence relation \(R\) on \(A\), maps \(A\to B\) constant on each class correspond bijectively to maps \(A/R\to B\). The forward map sends \(f\) to \(\bar f\) with \(\bar f([a])=f(a)\); the inverse precomposes with the quotient projection.
signature: Setoid.liftEquiv.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (r : Setoid α) : { f // r ≤ Setoid.ker f } ≃ (Quotient r → β)
